title: March Madness Precomputed Predictions Artifact
description: Season-specific pairwise matchup probabilities exported from an offline model such as RandomForest, sklearn MLP, Keras, or XGBoost.

season.description: Tournament season represented by the exported predictions.

prediction_format.description: Compact lookup-table format expected by the website for precomputed pairwise predictions.

team_ids.description: List of team IDs covered by the exported matchup table.

feature_importance.description: Optional global feature-importance ranking exported with the model artifact.

predictions.description: Map keyed by ordered matchup id '<team_a_id>:<team_b_id>'. Each value stores [winnerId, winnerProbability]. Storing both directions explicitly is recommended.

featureKey.description: Feature identifier aligned to the exported feature set.

importance.description: Global importance score as emitted by the offline model pipeline.

pairwisePrediction.description: Compact ordered-pair prediction stored as [winnerId, winnerProbability]. The ordered matchup key still defines team A and team B.

prefixItems.description: Winner selected from the exported probabilities.
Probability assigned to the winnerId for this ordered matchup.
